sprint_note: Adds catalog router, batch ingestion, Chronos skill, sparkline SVG redesign, list row layout, and UI token fixes.

files.role: Static catalog of valid measurement types. Source of truth for batch key validation and Chronos label mapping. Loaded at app startup.
content_outline: Array of definition objects: [{key, label, unit, value_type, description, aliases}]

Initial entries: weight (kg, decimal), body_fat_pct (%, decimal), body_water_pct (%, decimal), bmi (null unit, decimal), steps (steps, integer), sleep_hours (h, decimal), systolic_bp (mmHg, integer), diastolic_bp (mmHg, integer), heart_rate (bpm, integer), calories_kcal (kcal, integer)
key: snake_case canonical identifier — used as label_name in LabelEngine and as API key
aliases: list of alternative labels Chronos may receive (e.g. 'Weight' for key 'weight')

files.role: Catalog and batch ingestion router. Hosts GET /api/measurement-definitions and POST /api/measurements/batch.

public_objects.name: CATALOG_PATH
public_objects.purpose: Absolute path to measurement_definitions.json resolved relative to this file's location.

public_objects.name: CATALOG
public_objects.purpose: In-memory dict keyed by measurement key, loaded once at module import time from CATALOG_PATH.

methods.name: list_measurement_definitions
methods.purpose: GET /api/measurement-definitions — return all catalog entries as a Dataset ordered by label ASC.

methods.name: batch_ingest
methods.purpose: POST /api/measurements/batch — validate all keys and values, resolve keys to label_ids via SQL join, insert all measurements in a single transaction, return 201 {inserted: N}.

files.role: Pydantic request and response models. Adds BatchMeasurementEntry and BatchMeasurementRequest.
changes: [NEW] BatchMeasurementEntry(BaseModel): key: str, value: float
[NEW] BatchMeasurementRequest(BaseModel): recorded_at: str (ISO-8601, required), measurements: list[BatchMeasurementEntry]

files.role: Business logic service. Extends list_series_rows to return sparkline_points, min_value, max_value.
changes: [CHANGED] list_series_rows(): add sparkline_points (JSON array of {v: float, ts: int} — Unix epoch ms), min_value (float|null), max_value (float|null) per row. sparkline_points uses 20 most recent measurements ordered by recorded_at ASC. min/max computed over ALL measurements for the series.

[CHANGED] get_sparkline_values() is replaced by get_sparkline_points() returning list[dict] with keys v and ts. ts is extracted as: int(recorded_at.timestamp() * 1000) where recorded_at is a datetime object.
[NEW] get_series_stats(conn, label_id) -> dict: returns {min_value: float|null, max_value: float|null} from SELECT MIN(value), MAX(value) FROM numeric_series.measurements WHERE label_id = %s

files.role: Series and measurement CRUD router. LIST_SCHEMA updated to replace sparkline_values with sparkline_points and add min_value, max_value.
changes: [CHANGED] LIST_SCHEMA: remove ColumnSchema(key='sparkline_values', ...); add ColumnSchema(key='sparkline_points', label='Sparkline', type='string', sortable=False, filterable=False); add ColumnSchema(key='min_value', label='Min', type='number', sortable=False, filterable=False); add ColumnSchema(key='max_value', label='Max', type='number', sortable=False, filterable=False)
All endpoint handlers in series.py are unchanged. Only the LIST_SCHEMA constant changes.

files.role: FastAPI app entry point. Register catalog router.
changes: [NEW] from backend.routers.catalog import router as catalog_router
[NEW] app.include_router(catalog_router, prefix='/api') — registered before existing series and batch routers

files.role: Series list page. Redesigned sparkline and 4-column row layout.
changes: [REMOVED] recharts import (LineChart, Line, ResponsiveContainer)
[CHANGED] SeriesRow interface: replace sparkline_values: string with sparkline_points: string (JSON of [{v,ts}]); add min_value: number|null, max_value: number|null

[CHANGED] InlineSparkline: rewrite as plain SVG component. Props: {points: {v:number,ts:number}[], minVal: number|null, maxVal: number|null}. SVG dimensions: width 100%, height 28px. Time-proportional x: x = (ts - tsMin)/(tsMax - tsMin) * width. Normalized y: y = (1 - (v - minVal)/(maxVal - minVal)) * height. Edge cases: 0 points → render null; 1 point → render single circle cx=50% cy=14; identical values (min==max) → y = 14 (midline); identical timestamps (tsMax==tsMin) → x = 50%.
[CHANGED] Row div grid from '160px 1fr 80px' to '140px 1fr 70px 80px'. Columns: label | sparkline | min/max | latest_value.

[NEW] Min/max column: two spans stacked vertically (display:flex, flexDirection:column, alignItems:flex-end). Top span: max_value or '—'. Bottom span: min_value or '—'. Both use color:var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant) fontSize:0.75rem.
[CHANGED] InlineSparkline call: pass points={sparkData} minVal={row.min_value} maxVal={row.max_value} where sparkData = JSON.parse(row.sparkline_points).

files.role: Series detail page. Fixes input styling, timestamp display, and date/time input split.
changes: [CHANGED] Add measurement form: replace single datetime-local input with two inputs: type=date (addDate state) + type=time (addTime state). On submit: combine as localStr=addDate+'T'+addTime+':00'; compute browser UTC offset string (e.g. '+02:00') using getTimezoneOffset(); send recorded_at = localStr + offsetStr. Both inputs use theme token styles.

[CHANGED] Edit measurement form: replace single datetime-local input with two inputs (editDate, editTime). On startEdit: editDate = row.recorded_at.slice(0,10), editTime = row.recorded_at.slice(11,16). On submit: same timezone-aware combination as add form.

[CHANGED] All input inline styles: remove hardcoded hex (#121220, #444, #fff). Replace with: background:'var(--md-sys-color-surface)', border:'1px solid var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant)', color:'var(--md-sys-color-on-surface)', borderRadius:'4px', padding:'0.4rem'.

[CHANGED] Timestamp display: format recorded_at with new function formatTimestamp(raw: string): string. Uses new Date(raw).toLocaleString(undefined, {year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}). Apply in table td for recorded_at column.
[CHANGED] Table borders: replace hardcoded #2e2e3e / #1e1e2e with var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant).
[CHANGED] Empty state text color: replace hardcoded #888 with var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant).
[CHANGED] Measurements heading subtitle: change 'Series ID: {label_id}' paragraph to use var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant) for color (was hardcoded #888).

files.role: Chronos skill adapter for NumericSeries. Thin mapper from label/alias to catalog key; calls POST /api/measurements/batch.

methods.name: submit_measurements
methods.purpose: Map each {label, value} entry to a catalog key via case-insensitive match on key, label, and aliases. Fail with CHRONOS_UNMAPPED if not found. Fail with CHRONOS_AMBIGUOUS if multiple matches. Use current UTC ISO-8601 if recorded_at is None. Call POST /api/measurements/batch. Return response or raise on error.

methods.name: load_catalog
methods.purpose: Fetch GET /api/measurement-definitions from NUMERIC_SERIES_URL env var and return the rows list. Called once per skill invocation or cached.

private_objects.name: _resolve_key
private_objects.purpose: Case-insensitive exact match of label against each catalog entry's key, label, and aliases fields. Returns matched key. Raises ChronosUnmappedError if no match. Raises ChronosAmbiguousError if multiple matches.

test_batch_multiple_measurements — POST /api/measurements/batch with two entries; 201 {inserted:2}; both rows in DB
test_batch_unknown_key — POST /api/measurements/batch with unknown key; 422 UNKNOWN_KEY
test_batch_invalid_value — POST /api/measurements/batch with NaN/infinite value; 422 INVALID_VALUE

test_batch_series_not_found — POST with valid catalog key but no series row for that key; 422 SERIES_NOT_FOUND
test_sparkline_points_format — GET /api/series returns sparkline_points as JSON array of {v,ts} with ts as integer
